contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I dating from AD 321 (Reece period 16). BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS reverse type depicting a globe on an altar inscribed with VO/TIS/XX in three lines, probably with three stars above.
